title: 4 subclasses do not call super().__init__ (super-init-not-called)
detail: Subclasses at lines 94, 132, 175, and 272 set their attributes directly without calling super().__init__(). The base class may perform initialisation that the subclasses bypass. If the base class init is later updated, the subclasses will silently miss the new initialisation. Add explicit super().__init__() calls.

title: 4 overriding methods rename the 'pci_addr' parameter (arguments-renamed)
detail: Methods at lines 112, 157, 188, and 391 override a base-class method but rename the positional parameter (e.g., `pci_addr` → `phys_pci_addr`). Callers using keyword arguments would receive TypeError. Use the same parameter name as the base class or accept **kwargs.

title: 3 raise statements missing exception chaining
detail: At lines 76, 110, and 186, exceptions are re-raised inside except blocks without `from exc`. The original traceback context is lost, making debugging harder. Add `from exc` to each re-raise.
